best.explanation: Almagreira looks like a fun-sized north coast window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 96 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 78/100, and wind is the main risk.  An exposed north-coast beach break with more raw swell than Baleal; this is best for small, clean north-coast days when protected spots look underpowered; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: wind is over 30 km/h; wind fit is poor or too strong; gusts over 45 km/h add chop risk.
